episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: The doctor runs into an old flame.

episodes.title: Don't Ask Me Why
episodes.summary: Dr. Rush meets different clients in need of a fast, discreet medical "fix".

episodes.title: Learning to Fly
episodes.summary: Rush has to deal with a medical emergency and attempts to reach out to his estranged father. Eve needs to confront somebody from her past.

episodes.title: We Are Family
episodes.summary: Rush's lunch with his stepmother results in an unexpected outcome. Alex's marriage becomes under more pressure to his relationship with Rush.

episodes.title: Where Is My Mind?
episodes.summary: To try and cope with his anxiety, Rush takes any medical calls he gets. Eve discovers how valued she is.

episodes.title: You Spin Me Round
episodes.summary: While attending a medical conference, Rush and Alex plan a guys' weekend. Rush bumps into his ex and treats a politician. Eve tries to start again with Lucas.

episodes.title: Because I Got High
episodes.summary: Rush is introduced to a powerful hallucinogen that changes his perspective entirely. Alex gets a glimpse of Rush's lifestyle. Eve becomes concerned after belongings disappear from her apartment.

episodes.title: Get Lucky
episodes.summary: Rush is not pleased when he learns that Sarah has changed. Eve has some time with Manny and Alex maybe in too deep.

episodes.title: Dirty Work
episodes.summary: Sarah's efforts to find a sperm donor complicates things with Rush. Alex attempts to contain the fallout with his wife. Eve is encouraged to think about future possibilities.

episodes.title: Bitter Sweet Symphony
episodes.summary: Rush continues to be haunted by a ghost from his past. Eve has to deal with ramifications from seeing her ex. Steffi has a shocking proposal.
